snippet.title: Tiberium Dusk 1.27 - Renegade Flame Tank Showcase (+ more)
snippet.description:
Showcase of Renegade Flame Tanks with a new firing method that's unique amongst faction flame tanks, firing a Tiberian Dawn "stream" of flame that has a chance of spawning damaging fires. This fire penetrates targets and damages all along its flight path. 

Also shown is the Purifying Flames upgrade  friendly fire nerf (buying purifying flames greatly reduces friendly fire damage from the fireballs) and the Tiberium Tank's improved chemical spreading / AOE damage.

Mod: https://www.moddb.com/mods/tiberium-dusk
Discord server: https://discord.gg/8Cpfepqczy
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/c/user/posts?u=19313305
